snippet.title: Season 3 Update Trailer | Resident Evil: Survive (Openbor Beat Em Up Game) #jillvalentine #nemesis
snippet.description:
New Season 3 update of Resident Evil: Survive, featuring content based on Resident Evil 3: Nemesis.

- If this is your first time playing Resident Evil: Survive download the full rar file and play the exe.
- If you're getting the latest update, just replace your old RESIDENT EVIL SURVIVE.PAK game file located in your paks folder of your previous build.

0:00 - Patreon
0:36 - Jill Valentine
0:54 - Carlos Oliveira
1:08 - Mikhail Viktor
1:18 - Nikolai Zinoviev
1:36 - New Game Mode
2:06 - General Gameplay
2:31 - Nemesis
